sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: All for the Show - Supremacy is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov Arena.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Everything we do here is for the crowd. And they love the smell of gunpowder, blood, explosions, screams. They want a spectacle. But more than that, they need someone to root for. What's the point of watching a fight if you're not backing anyone? The crowd remembers trademarks best. A signature weapon. A signature fighting style. And I've already come up with one for you. Grab an AK-12 and go conquer the Arena!"

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Earn a Match MVP after eliminating 5 or more enemies with AK-12
